description: Radio Soma is THE way to listen to your favorite stations from soma fm on Windows 8. Radio Soma provides access to all 24 live stations from soma fm. Stations are categorized into 10 different genres including alternative, ambient, electronica, and world, making it easy to find music to suit you mood. Have a favorite? If there are stations that you really groove to, add them to your favorites so they're easily accessible when the app starts. Want to share? If you're listening to a station you think your friends might want to groove to as well, share it and let them know about it.
